# Handoff

- done: Static Japanese document-tab workspace, all fixture cases, responsive row behavior, document/item switching, closing, choosers, keyboard navigation and focus return.
- done: Official supplied Lucide SVG files copied unchanged into `icons/`.
- no build: See `README.md` for the local launch command.

- Tool: Chromium via Playwright (`node check.cjs`).

- Visual inspection: `evidence-desktop.png`, `evidence-mobile.png`, and `evidence-chooser.png`.

- Recheck: desktop overflow controls, document selection, per-document item preservation, narrow document chooser, item chooser, item updates, and focus return all passed.

## Remaining gaps
- Browser coverage is bounded to Chromium at representative 1000px and 390px viewports; no human approval is implied.
EOF
cd /bench/app && node check.cjs
